subject.gist: A boilermaker cashed out his retirement for land, then began building a cordwood home from his woods while sharing a cramped cabin with Sunni.

story.text: Jason cannot picture himself still working inside boilers at seventy, so he cashes out his retirement for land and sets about building a home with Sunni. Cedar from their woods becomes the frame and cordwood walls; bottles hunted out of recycling bins become glowing trees and rivers. His welding experience helps him move enormous timbers, but affordable materials demand an enormous amount of labour. After ten years in their cramped temporary cabin, they are thoroughly ready to move. The new house still needs finishing, and the grandchildren's bunks and climbing wall are plans. Jason's answer is to get up each day and keep going.

coverage.title: Arrival and wooded property
coverage.visible: Road, small buildings, woodland, and first overview of the cordwood house.
coverage.gaps: No survey or complete property boundary. The white clapboard building under a metal roof in the opening montage (frame-0006) is not the occupied cabin.

coverage.title: House exterior and local timber
coverage.visible: Multiple gable-front, side and aerial views; standing-seam roof, chimney, posts, glass openings and cordwood infill.
coverage.gaps: Metric footprint and hidden details remain uncertain.

coverage.title: Earlier tree felling
coverage.visible: Portrait-format footage of cutting timber.
coverage.gaps: Historical construction footage, not the current property state.

coverage.title: Timber frame and openings
coverage.visible: House facades, eaves, timber members, and ceiling underside.
coverage.gaps: Edited views require landmark matching; beam counts in narration are not independently counted.

coverage.title: Route to the temporary cabin
coverage.visible: Walking outdoors, a reverse house view, and approach to a small cabin.
coverage.gaps: Cuts interrupt the route; relative cabin/house distance is unknown.

coverage.title: Temporary cabin interior
coverage.visible: Ladder, sleeping loft, compact kitchen, heating stove, ceiling, and brief toilet/shower area.
coverage.gaps: Cramped partly occluded views; toilet type comes from narration.

coverage.title: Screened porch and daily life
coverage.visible: Cedar porch posts, screen enclosure, exterior relationship to cabin, and red hanging hearth.
coverage.gaps: Porch attachment visible; dimensions and insulation performance unmeasured.

coverage.title: Return to cordwood home; recycled glass
coverage.visible: Reverse exterior, colored wall panels, face-shaped green glass, and bottles collected in bins.
coverage.gaps: Bath identification is spoken; individual bottle counts not checked.

coverage.title: Interior, bottle patterns and structural posts
coverage.visible: Cordwood/glass infill, large natural posts, open main room, partition faces and exposed roof underside.
coverage.gaps: Interior connects by visible openings; full floor plan still incomplete.

coverage.title: Handling logs
coverage.visible: Historical felling and skid-steer footage, then present demonstration of homemade log dolly.
coverage.gaps: Historical equipment operation must not be treated as current object placement.

coverage.title: Sawmill, slabs and construction sequence
coverage.visible: Mill and rails, slab stacks, plus earlier frame erection, roof framing and decking.
coverage.gaps: Multiple dates; not one photogrammetry scene. Earlier joints can constrain form but not finish state.

coverage.title: Cordwood laying
coverage.visible: Exterior wall and opening details; construction cutaways show mortar beads and log placement.
coverage.gaps: Alternates current finished surfaces and unfinished work.

coverage.title: Examples of other cordwood buildings
coverage.visible: Historic and illustrative buildings from elsewhere.
coverage.gaps: Exclude these structures from this property catalogue and reconstruction.

coverage.title: Cedar stock and material behavior
coverage.visible: Stacked cordwood, a lifted piece, and construction detail cutaways.
coverage.gaps: Claims about rot, insects and swelling are attributed explanations, not verified engineering guidance.

coverage.title: Knee wall, wall thickness and insulation
coverage.visible: Stone base, door reveal, repeated aerial frontage, and shaving close-up.
coverage.gaps: R-values and inch dimensions are owner estimates; whole-wall performance not measured.

coverage.title: Living area, frame and future doors
coverage.visible: Wood stove, sliding openings, timber supports, partition openings, walnut boards.
coverage.gaps: Door blanks are current; completed heavy doors and special hinges are plans.

coverage.title: Mortar finishing and work routine
coverage.visible: Bottle reveals, tuck-pointing demonstrations, earlier plaster/mortar work and wide interior.
coverage.gaps: Mixed construction phases; current finish not uniform.

coverage.title: Lath and lime-plaster partitions
coverage.visible: Lath strips, studs, plaster coats and arched/rectangular openings.
coverage.gaps: Some rooms unfinished; no room label is inferred from an unlabeled doorway.

coverage.title: Bottle-log assembly and light
coverage.visible: Cut bottle halves and aluminum flashing demonstrated; lit exterior at dusk.
coverage.gaps: Assembly is shown; insulation equivalence is an unverified spoken claim.

coverage.title: Shower artwork and planned floor finish
coverage.visible: Tree/river glass motifs, bright shower panel, arched shower entry, unfinished floor.
coverage.gaps: Nearby spring is described as artistic inspiration; not mapped as a water supply.

coverage.title: Remaining material and closing exterior views
coverage.visible: Slab stacks, worksite, property overviews, main house and older installation cutaways.
coverage.gaps: 126 versus 128 tree totals conflict; do not silently reconcile.

coverage.title: Planned grandchildren room and closing interior
coverage.visible: Unfinished room, rectangular and arched openings, bathroom/shower glimpse.
coverage.gaps: Triple bunks and climbing wall are proposed, not installed.

coverage.title: Final aerial and end card
coverage.visible: Near-overhead view of the roof followed by credits.
coverage.gaps: Final aerial reserved for evaluation; credits add no scene coverage.
